themes_detail.label: Park Noise Explosion
themes_detail.summary: Park noise complaints spiked to 4 THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 0.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 3100% spike (z-score: 11.72)—suggesting a sudden new source of disruption in a district where park access is a persistent community board budget request.
evidence: 4 park noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (3100% spike, z-score 11.72)
Spike is statistically extreme and emerged suddenly, not gradual
Community board has repeatedly requested park improvements (CB budget request [01])
reporting_angles: Identify which park(s) are generating complaints and what the noise source is (construction, events, equipment, vendors)
Interview residents and park users about impact on quality of life and park usability

themes_detail.label: Graffiti Surge Two Weeks Ago
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints jumped to 33 TWO WEEKS AGO versus a baseline of 4.5 per week (633% spike, z-score: 5.88), indicating a coordinated tagging campaign or deteriorating conditions in specific neighborhood corridors.
evidence: 33 graffiti complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 4.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (633% increase, z-score 5.88)
Spike suggests concentrated event or campaign rather than ambient condition
Related to street/infrastructure concerns (Street Sign Damaged also up 471% same timeframe)
reporting_angles: Map which blocks and corridors saw the heaviest tagging and whether there's a pattern (gang activity, crew, protest)
Check with NYPD on recent activity and with Sanitation on cleanup response times

themes_detail.label: Tree Damage & Illegal Removal
themes_detail.summary: Over the PAST 2 WEEKS, complaints about dead/dying trees (3 vs. 0.2 baseline, +1100%) and illegal tree damage (3 vs. 0.5 baseline, +500%) converged, suggesting environmental degradation or unauthorized removal in the district.
evidence: Dead/Dying Tree complaints: 3 last week vs. 0.2 baseline (1100% spike, z-score 6.35)
Illegal Tree Damage complaints: 3 two weeks ago vs. 0.5 baseline (500% spike, z-score 5.0)
Two distinct but related tree-focused spikes suggest systemic issue with street tree canopy or maintenance
reporting_angles: Investigate whether construction (503 DOB permits filed recently) is damaging street trees or whether maintenance is being deferred
Interview Parks Department on tree inventory status and whether East New York/Cypress Hills has adequate canopy for a low-income district

themes_detail.label: Unleashed Dogs & Public Safety
themes_detail.summary: Unleashed dog complaints jumped to 4 TWO WEEKS AGO versus a baseline of 0.5 per week (700% spike, z-score: 4.95), potentially signaling enforcement gaps or a shift in off-leash dog behavior in parks and streets.
evidence: 4 unleashed dog complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average (700% spike, z-score 4.95)
Coincides with park noise spike and park improvement budget requests, suggesting park usage/enforcement issues
May be linked to park noise complaints if parks are busier or enforcement is lighter
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Enforcement Patrol on staffing and dog park violations in the district
Collect resident accounts of dangerous encounters and whether it's a specific location or systemic

themes_detail.label: Sidewalk & Infrastructure Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Root/Sewer/Sidewalk condition complaints rose to 12 LAST WEEK versus a baseline of 4.1 per week (191% spike, z-score: 4.01), and street sign damage hit 5 TWO WEEKS AGO versus 0.9 baseline (471% spike), indicating cascading infrastructure wear.
evidence: Root/Sewer/Sidewalk complaints: 12 last week vs. 4.1 baseline (191% spike, z-score 4.01)
Street Sign Damaged: 5 two weeks ago vs. 0.9 baseline (471% spike, z-score 3.92)
503 recent DOB permits (319 alterations) may be exacerbating subsurface and sidewalk damage
reporting_angles: Cross-reference DOB alteration permits with 311 complaints to see if construction is triggering sidewalk/sewer damage
Interview DOE on sidewalk repair backlog and whether the district is getting adequate maintenance
